style.layoutRule: Adapt a native specimen copy, retaining its page setup, typography and actual inline signature. Use 8 pt paragraph spacing for letter readability, 2 pt in the header and closing; inspect the native PDF export. Do not rebuild in another renderer.
style.signatureRule: Insert the actual Jamie-authorized signature image between the closing and typed name. Never synthesize handwriting or crop a typed name and call it a signature.

scope: Every maintained cover letter derives PDF and review siblings from the canonical cover-letter portfolio, including historical do-not-submit benchmarks.
limitations: The approved signature is a visual handwritten image, not a cryptographic digital signature. Readiness is bound to each exact exported PDF and inspection receipt; it does not authorize application submission.
